With invalid IF/ID, stale CSR/MRET-looking data never blocks permitted target fetch at the next edge after redirect; valid serial tokens still wait for older stages. Evidence: Pre-edge request/post-edge response and event traces including reset epochs and stale-data regression.

Evidence: Reset/stimulus waveform, before/after event and bus traces, fresh reset-epoch initial images.

Compute nominal side sqrt(A/0.40), planned width ceil(side/0.46)*0.46 and height ceil(side/2.72)*2.72; planned core is [10,10,10+width,10+height] um and planned die is [0,0,width+20,height+20] um. Invoke stock native initialize_floorplan with explicit planned core/die, site unithd, approved binary and two-thread policy; retain manifest-bound technology LEF and make_tracks.tcl. Derive expected native legal bounds independently on the calibrated grid anchored at die origin (0,0): lower x/y bounds round inward upward to 0.46/2.72 um grids, upper x/y bounds round inward downward to those grids. Enumerate actual ODB rows/sites to derive origins, orientations, dimensions, per-row site counts, total legal site area and union bbox; cross-check ODB getCoreArea against the native legal-row bbox in integer DBU. At placement and final physical export, repeat row/site and pin legality checks and bind results to the actual database. The nonempty actual native legal-row region agrees with stock generation/inward snapping, is contained in planned core and actual die, and has at least 10 um margin to all four die sides. Row/site grid, orientations and all placements obey the frozen technology/site rules. Planning bbox and legal-row bbox are distinct measurements and equality between them is not required. Never substitute occupied-instance bbox for either, force off-grid rows, alter stock track phases, silently enlarge the die or spoof core/row metadata. Retain nominal 40% planning target, aspect 1, 10 um margins and placement density 0.55; report achieved planned and legal-row utilization/aspect separately with explicit mapped-area numerator, actual area denominator and stage, rather than force legal-row utilization to 40%. Report actual legal-site whitespace and CTS/repair/support-cell accounting within the existing nominal 60% planning reserve, with no hidden reserve. Every fixed top pin must have recorded location/layer and pass frozen horizontal met3/vertical met2, stock track-phase, spacing and corner-clearance checks. No pads/macros/fixed die budget or new area ceiling. Failure of snapping, nonempty containment, margins, metadata or pin/site legality is an actual failure; no waiver or new numeric geometry tolerance. Evidence: Written geometry report with actual A/netlist hash, independently computed planned core/die and areas, actual DBU units/die/getCoreArea/legal-row bbox, complete row origins/orientations/site names/dimensions/counts, total legal site area, separate placed-instance area/occupied bbox, planned/legal utilization and aspect, four measured margins, per-bit pin/layer/track/spacing legality, support-cell/whitespace accounting and exact database/tool/revision hashes. execution_policy.base_suite: Run every applicable base CPU functional/cycle/protocol test in both core configurations, and run integration smoke/workloads on the enabled physical top. Standalone NPU checks exercise its specified internal interface.
execution_policy.completion: Whole-project PASS requires passing evidence for every required item and every configuration, complete 443-ID trace coverage, valid common execution, no pending/missing result or required adapter, plus required physical/GDS closure. Report-only metrics require honest measured values or explicit supported-model unavailability; they have no numerical budget.
execution_policy.downstream_permissions: Stage ownership denotes evidence responsibility, not a write/tool authorization. Delivery and evaluator owners must execute in their own granted scopes; this draft adds no workflow task or permission.
execution_policy.evidence: Each item result must carry check ID, stable requirement IDs/design groups, baseline/constraint/RTL hashes, actual command/tool identities, run/configuration/ELF/seed/reset/bus schedule, raw logs and retrievable evidence hashes. Bind external contract operands and results to actual same-run objects; free hashes or constant PASS flags do not satisfy acceptance.
execution_policy.functional_evidence_reuse: The geometry/tool revision permits qualified functional evidence reuse only after exact source, signed specification, qualified RTL, immutable checker/corpus, configuration and original runtime/evidence binding are verified. Archive the reuse decision and original run identities; mark results reused rather than newly executed. Incompatible or unresolved evidence requires rerun. This plan-authoring task does not certify the supplied verification report or execute a functional/physical run.
execution_policy.physical_revalidation: Rerun or revalidate affected floorplan, rows/pins, placement, CTS/repair, routing/extraction, setup/hold/electrical, router/independent DRC, LVS, antenna and final exports with actual selected binary, two threads and new formal inputs. Require fresh evidence for the external reset waveform and retain all recovery/removal/library pulse checks. A previously saved checkpoint may be considered only after explicit input, stage and design compatibility checks; unchanged filenames or numeric results do not establish qualification.
execution_policy.physical_revision: Every affected physical-stage result must identify this confirmed/frozen acceptance revision and constraints revision 2 by actual immutable artifact/file hashes, the same signed specification and qualified implementation. Source the prescribed environments, explicitly invoke the selected OpenROAD path and verify actual resolved bytes/version after environment loads; record NUM_CORES=2 and actual tool threads=2. Ambient PATH selection, a version probe detached from the execution binary, or old 26Q3/16-core measurements do not qualify.
execution_policy.results: Keep NOT_RUN/PENDING, PASS, FAIL, TIMEOUT and INVALID distinct. A qualified runtime retains the immutable checker FAIL/TIMEOUT; invalid or missing lineage is INVALID. Every required run remains in fixed totals. A timeout is non-passing, not a diagnosis.
execution_policy.scope: Reference calibration and historical results never count as DUT execution. ACT4 subset success is not certification. Single-corner engineering closure does not imply foundry release or silicon results.
